verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure that external AI agents run on, through integrations with Claude/OpenAI Computer Use, CrewAI, AgentKit, Browser-Use and an MCP exposure, plus skills installed into the user's own agent. None of the evidence documents a built-in AI assistant inside Steel itself that a user can hand tasks to. These are developer building blocks for bringing your own agent, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
